_help: Edit this to change how the council runs, then: python council.py "your question" --config council.config.json  (or use run.ps1 / run.sh). The Claude-only inline method does NOT use this file. provider options: ollama (free, local, no key) | groq | openrouter | gemini (free cloud keys) | openai | anthropic | auto.

_example_fusion_multi_brain._note: Claude + GPT + Gemini on one question; the Adversary is always a different brand than the Arbiter. Keys go in ~/.claude/fusion.env. Run: council.py "Q" --provider fusion
